lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai
couplets.en: At every turn you ask what I amount to.

lines: Tum hi kaho ki ye andaaz-e guftagu kya hai
couplets.en: You tell me, then, what kind of talk is this?

lines: Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qail
couplets.en: I set little store by blood that merely runs in the veins.

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahu kya hai
couplets.en: If it never falls from the eye, what sort of blood is it?

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahu kya hai
couplets.en: If it never falls from the eye, what sort of blood is it?

lines: Chipak raha hai badan par lahu se pairahan
couplets.en: My shirt clings to my body with blood.

lines: Hamari jeb ko ab haajat-e rafu kya hai
couplets.en: What need is there now to mend my torn collar?

lines: Jala hai jism jahan dil bhi jal gaya hoga
couplets.en: Where the body burned, the heart must have burned too.

lines: Kuredte ho jo ab raakh, justuju kya hai
couplets.en: What are you looking for now, sifting through the ash?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai
couplets.en: At every turn you ask what I amount to.

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e guftaar aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: The strength to speak is gone, and even if it were to return.

lines: To kis ummeed pe kahiye ki aarzoo kya hai
couplets.en: With what hope would I say what I long for?
